answer: Peers cross-attest via signed comet-stamped checkpoints, and reputation decays unless renewed. Require each agent to stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens locked to a unique hardware root key; identity registration costs this bond plus a small anti-spam fee, so spawning N sybils costs N bonds that are slashed on collusion proof. A nebula-style gossip layer propagates revocation fast, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
